name: Favored
description: Gain a bonus to damage rolls equal to a trait of your choice.

name: Invigorating
description: On a successful attack, roll a d4. On a result of 4, gain a Focus.

name: Quick
description: When you make an attack, you can spend a Focus or mark a Stress to target another creature within range with that attack.

name: Reliable
description: Gain a +1 bonus to your attack rolls.

name: Aggressive
description: Gain a -1 penalty to your Evasion. On a successful attack, roll an additional damage die and discard the lowest result.

name: Anchored
description:
Gain a +2 bonus to your damage thresholds.

While in this stance, you can’t be moved against your will.

name: Defensive
description: Attack rolls targeting you from within Melee range have disadvantage unless the attacker marks a Stress to negate the disadvantage.

name: Otherworldly
description: On a successful attack, you can deal physical or magic damage.

name: Grappling
description: On a successful attack within Melee range, you can spend a Focus or mark a Stress to temporarily Restrain the target or throw the target up to Close range.

name: Scary
description: On a successful attack, the target must mark a Stress.

name: Stable
description: You can spend a Focus instead of an Armor Slot to reduce damage.

name: Vigilant
description: When you are targeted by an attack, you can mark a Stress to gain a d6 bonus to your Evasion against the attack.

name: Crushing
description: When you deal Severe damage, you can spend a Hope to force the target to mark an additional Hit Point.

name: Exacting
description: When you roll a 1 on a damage die, you can treat it as the highest value on the die instead.

name: Honed
description: Spend a Focus before you make an attack roll to gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for that attack.

name: Isolating
description: Gain advantage on attack rolls when there are no other creatures within Very Close range of you or your target.
